title: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Aggregate Industries d/b/a the Holcim Group.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 07-GC-19)
